s: puM, vizRumUrttiviSezaH । sa ca gaRqakyudBavavajrakIwakftacakrayuktaSilA dvArakodBavatAdfSaSilA ca । tasya mAhAtmyalakzaRAdi yaTA, -- “prasaNgAt kaTayizyAmi SAlagrAmaSilArccanam । nizkAmo muktimApnoti mUrttiM DyAyan stuvan japan ॥ SaNKacakragadApadmaM keSavAKyo gadADaraH । sAbjakOmodakIcakraSaNKI nArAyaRo viBuH ॥ sa ca SaNKAbjapado mADavaH SrIgadADaraH । gadAbjaSaNKacakrI vA govindAKyo gadADaraH ॥ padmaSaNKAdigadine vizRuSaNKAya vE namaH । saSaNKAbjagadAcakramaDusUdanamUrttaye ॥ namo gadAsicakrAbjayuktatrEvikramAya ca । sAvikOmodakIpadmaSaNKavAmanamUrttaye ॥ SaNKAbjacakragadine namaH SrIDaramUrttaye । hfzIkeSa sAvigadASaNKapadminnamo'stu te ॥ sAbjaSaNKagadAcakrapadmanABasvarUpiRe । dAmodara SaNKagadAcakrapadminnamo'stu te ॥ sAviSaNKagadAbjAya vAsudeva namo namaH । SaNKAbjacakragadine damaH saNkarzaRAya ca ॥ SaNKacakragadAbjAya DftapradyumnamUrttaye । namo'nirudDAya gadASaNKAbjavaraDAriRe ॥ sAbjaSaNKagadAcakrapuruzottamamUrttaye । namo'DokzajarUpAya gadASaNKaviDAriRe ॥ nfsiMhamUrttaye padmagadASaNKaviDAriRe । padmAviSaNKagadine namo'stvacyutamUrttaye ॥ saSaNKacakrAbjagadaM janArddanamiho namaH । upendraM gadinaM sAvipadmaSaNKa namo'stu te ॥ sacakrAbjagadASaNKayuktAya harimUrttaye । sagadAbjAviSaNKAya namaH SrIkfzRamUrttaye ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAdbAragatalagnadvicakraDfk । SuklABAKyaSca so'vyAdbaH sadEva SrIgadADaraH ॥ lagnadvicakro cakrABaH pUrvvaBAgastu puzkalaH । saNkarzaRo'Ta pradyumnaH sUkzmacakrastu pItakaH ॥ sa dIrGaH sa SiraSCidro yo'nirudDastu varttulaH । nAnAhAradbireKaSca aTa nArAyaRo'sitaH ॥ maDye gadAkftA reKA nABipadmamahonnataH । pfTucakro nfsiMho vaH kapilo'vyAttribindukaH ॥ aTavA paYcabindustatpUjanaM brahmacAriRaH । varAhaSaktiliNgo'vyAdvizamadbayacakrakaH ॥ nIlastrireKaH sTUlo'Ta kUrmmamUrttiH svabindumAn । kfzRaH savarttulAvarttaH pARqaronnatapfzWakaH ॥ SrIDaraH paYcareKo'vyAdvanamAlAgadANkitaH । vAmano varttulo nAma vAmacakraH sureSvaraH ॥ nAnAvarRo'nekamUrttirnAgaBogI tvanantakaH । sTUlo dAmodaro nIlo maDye cakraH sunIlakaH ॥ saMkIrRadvArako vo'vyAdaTa brahmA sumohitaH । sadIrGareKA Suzira ekacakrAmbujaH pfTuH ॥ pratyucCidraH sTUlacakraH kfzRo'binduSca bindumat । hayagrIvo'NkuSAkAraH paYcareKaH mamantataH ॥ vEkuRWo'malavadBAti ekacakrAtmako'sitaH । matsyo dIrGAmbujAkAro dbArareKastu pARqaraH ॥ vAmacakro dakzareKaH SyAmo vo'vyAttrivikramaH । SAlagrAme dvArakAyAM sTitAya gadine namaH ॥ ekena lakzito vo'vyAdgadADArI sudarSanaH । lakzmInArAyaRo dvAByAM triBirmUrttistrivikramaH ॥ caturBiSca caturvyUho vAsudevaSca paYcaBiH । pradyumnaH zaqBirevAvyAt saNkarzaRa itaH stutaH ॥ puruzottamo'zwaBiH syAcca navavyUho navAnnitaH । daSAvatAro daSaBiranirudDo'vatAdaTa । dvAdaSAtmA dvAdaSaBirata UrdDvo hyanantakaH ॥” iti pAdme pAtAlaKaRqe 10 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । ISvara uvAca । “SAlagrAme maRO yantre maRqale pratimAsu ca । nityantu SrIhareH pUjA kevalena jalena tu ॥ gaRqakyAmekadeSe tu SAlagrAmasTalaM mahat । pAzARAntarBavaM yattat SAlagrAmamiti sTitam ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAsparSAt kowijanmAGanASanam । kiM punarjananaM tatra hareH sAnniDyakAraRam ॥ SAlagrAmEkayajanAt SataliNgaPalaM laBet । bahuBirjanmaBiH puRyEryadi kfzRaSilAM laBet ॥ gozpadena ca cihnena tena vE trAyate naraH । AdO SilAM parIkzeta snigDAM SrezWAYca mecakAm ॥ akfzRA maDyamA proktA miSrA miSraPalapradA । sarvvakAmapradA sOmyA karAlA BayaduHKadA ॥ snigDA ca SrIkarI nityaM rUkzA dAridryadAyikA । kzudrA kzudraPalA proktA sTUlA sTUlaPalapradA ॥ sadA kAzWe sTito vahnirmanTane ca prakASate । yaTA taTA harirvyApI SAlagrAme prakASate ॥ pratyahaM dbAdaSa SilAH SAlagrAmasya yo'rccayet । dvAravatyAH SilAyuktAH sa vEkuRWe mahIyate ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAyAntu gahvaraM lakzyate naraH । pitarastasya tizWanti tfptAH kalpAntaraM divi ॥ SAlagrAmaSilA yatra yatra dvAravatISilA । mfte vizRupuraM yAti kftArTaM yojanatrayam ॥ japapUjA ca homaSca sarvvaM kowiguRaM Bavet । manaskAmaH sadABIzwaM kroSamAtraM samantataH ॥ kIkawe'pi mfto yAti vEkuRWaBavanaM naraH । SAlagrAmaSilAyAM yo mUlyamutpAdayennaraH ॥ vikretA cAnumantA ca yaH parIkzAnumodakaH । sarvva te narakaM yAnti yAvadAhUtasaMplavam । atastaM varjjayeddevi ! harivikrayaRakrayam । SAlagrAmodBavo devo yo devo dvArakodBavaH । uBayoH saNgamo yatra muktistatra na saMSayaH ॥ dvArakodBavaH SuklaSca bahucakreRa cihnitaH । cakramAsIt SivAkAracitsvarUpaniraYjanam ॥ namo'stvoNkArarUpAya sadAnandasvarUpiRe । SAlagrAme mahABAga BaktasyAnugrahaM kuru । tvayA yutasya Darmmasya fRagrastasya me praBo ॥” iti tatrEva 11 aDyAyaH ॥ aparaYca । brAhmaRa uvAca । “gaRqakIyaM nadI rAjan ! surAsuranizevitA । puRyodakaparIvAhErhatapAtakasaYcayA ॥ darSanAnmAnasaM pApaM sparSanAt karmmajaM dahet । vAcikaM svIyatoyasya pAnataH pApasaYcayam ॥ purA duzwAH prajAnATaH prajAH sarvvA vipApmanaH । svagaRqAdbipruzo'nekapApaGnIM sfzwavAnimAm ॥ enAM nadIM ye puRyodAM spfSanti sutaraNgiRIm । te garBaBAjo nEva syurapi pApakfto narAH ॥ tasyAM BavA ye cASmAnaScakracihnEralaNkftAH । te sAkzAdBagavanto hi svasvarUpaDarAH parAH ॥ SilAH saMpUjayedyastu nityaM cakrayutAH sadA । na jAtucijjananyA vE jaWaraM samupAviSet ॥ pUjayed yo naro DImAn SAlagrAmaSilAM varAm । tenAcAravatA BAvyaM damBamohaviyoginA ॥ paradAraparadravyavimuKena nareRa ca । pUjanIyaH prayatnena SAlagrAmaH sacakrakaH ॥ dvAravatyA BavaM cakraM SilA vE gaRqakIBavA । puMsAM kzaRAdDarantyeva pApaM janmaSatArjjitam ॥ api pApasahasrARAM karttA tAvannaro Bavet । SAlagrAmaSilA ApaH pItvA pUyeta tatkzaRAt ॥ brAhmaRaH kzattriyo vESyaH SUdro vedapaTe sTitaH । SAlagrAmaM pUjayitvA gfhasTo mokzamApnuyAt ॥ na kadAcit striyA kAryyaM SAlagrAmasya pUjanam । BarttfdInATa suBagA sarvvalokahitEzayA ॥ mohAt spfSeta mahilA janmaSIlaguRAnvitA । hitvA puRyasamUhantu satvaraM narakaM vrajet ॥ strIpARimuktapuzpARi SAlagrAmaSilopari । parEraDikapApAni vadanti brAhmaRottamAH ॥ candanaM vizapaNkABaM kuNkumaM vajrasanniBam । nEvedyaM kAlakUwABaM BavedBagavataH kftam ॥ tasmAt sarvvAtmanA tyAjyaH striyAH sparSaH Silopari । kurvvatI yAti narakaM yAvadindrAScaturdaSa ॥ * ॥ api pApasamAcAro brahmahatyAyuto'pi vA । SAlagrAmaSilAtoyaM pItvA yAti parAM gatim ॥ tulasI candanaM cakraM SaNKo GaRwATa cakrakam । SilA tAmrasya pAtrantu vizRornAma padAmftam ॥ padAmftantu navaBiH pAparASipradAhakam । vadanti munayaH SAntAH sarvvaSAstrArTakovidAH ॥ sarvvatIrTaparisnAnAt sarvvakratusamarccanAt । puRyaM Bavati yadrAjan bindO bindO tadadButam ॥ SAlagrAmaSilA yatra pUjyate puruzottamEH । tatra yojanamAtrantu tIrTakowisamanvitam ॥ * ॥ SAlagrAmAH samAH pUjyAH samezu dvitayaM na hi । viSamA eva pUjyA vE vizamezu trayaM na hi ॥ dvAravatIBavaM cakraM taTA vE gaRqakIBavam । uBayoH saNgamo yatra tatra gaNgA samudragA ॥ rUkzAH kurvvanti puruzAn AyuHSrIBirvivarjjitAn । tasmAt snigDA manohArirUpeRa dadati Sriyam ॥ AyuzkAmo naro yastu DanakAmo'pi yaH pumAn । pUjayan sarvvamApnoti pApaM lOkikamEhikam ॥ prARAntakAle tu yasya BavedBAgyabalAnnfpa । vAci nAma hareH puRyaM SilAkftistadantike ॥ gacCatsu prARamArgezu yasya viSramBato'pi cet । SAlagrAmaSilAmUrttistadA muktirna saMSayaH ॥ purA BagavatA proktamambarIzAya DImate । brAhmaRo nyAsino BaktAH SAlagrAmaSilA mama ॥ svarUpatritayaM mahyametadDi kzitimaRqale । pApinAM pApanirvvAraM karttuM DftamudaYcatAm ॥ nindanti pApino ye vA SAlagrAmaSilAM sakft । kumBIpAke pacantyASu yAvadAhUtasaMplavam ॥ pUjAM samudyataM karttuM yo vArayati mUQaDIH । tasya mAtA pitA banDuH sarvve narakagAminaH ॥ yo vE kaTayati SrezWaM SAlagrAmArccanaM kuru । sa kftArTo nayatyASu vEkuRWaM svantu pUrvvajEH ॥” iti ca tatrEva 20 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । SrIISvara uvAca । “SAlagrAmaSilAyAntu trElokyaM sacarAcaram । sadA vasati tenAtra vizRustizWati sarvvadA ॥ SAlagrAmaSilApUjAM prakuruzva zaqAnana । gaNgAmiva mahApuRyAM caturvvargaPalapradAm ॥ hfzwena manasA yena sTApitA pUjitA taTA । yajYakowisamaM puRyaM ASu tasmE prayacCati ॥ Cinnastena mahAsena garBavAsaH sudAruRaH । pItaM yena sadA vizRoH SAlagrAmaSilAjalam ॥ kAmAsakto'pi yo nityaM BaktiBAvavivarjjitaH । SAlagrAmaSilAM paSyet tasya pApakzayo Bavet ॥ SAlagrAmaSilA vipra hatyAkowivinASinI । smftA saMkIrttitA DyAtA pUjitA ca namaskftA ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAM dfzwvA yAnti pApAni dehinAm । siMhaM dfzwvA yaTA yAnti vane mfgagaRA BayAt ॥ namaskftvA tu yaH kuryyAt SAlagrAmaSilArccanam । BaktyA vA yadi vABaktyA sa muktiM samavApnuyAt ॥ yaH sevAM kurute nityaM SAlagrAmaSilAgrataH । vEvasvatAdBayaM tasya na syAnmaraRajanmanI ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAcakraM payodaDiGftAdikEH । yaH snApayati nUnaM sa kalpakowiM vaseddivi ॥ SAlagrAme namaskAro BAvenApi ca yEH kftaH । mAnavAH kiM karizyanti madBaktyA te mahItale ॥ madBaktiraRadarpizWA matpraBuM na namanti ye । vEzRavAste na vijYeyA madBaktAH pApamohitAH । SAlagrAmaSilA yatra tatra puttra vasAmyaham ॥ pUjito'haM na tErmartyEH sTApitaSca na tErnarEH । na kftaM martyaloke yEH SAlagrAmaSilArccanam ॥ kimarccitErliNgaSatErvizRuBaktibahizkftEH । SAlagrAmaSilAcakraM nArcitaM yadi puttraka ॥ janmakowisahasreRa pUjite mayi yat Palam । tat PalaM samavApnoti SAlagrAmaSilArccanAt ॥ anarhyaM mama nEvedyaM patraM puzpaM PalaM jalam । SAlagrAmaSilAdfzwaM sarvvaM yAti pavitratAm ॥ nEvedyaM me na BoktavyaM BuktvA cAndrAyaRaM caret । BuktvA keSavanEvedyaM kowiBaktiPalaM laBet ॥ sakfdaByarccito vizRuH SAlagrAmaSilAsTitaH । dadAti vipulAM muktiM sarvvasaNgavivarjjitAm ॥ malliNgakowiBirdfzwEryat PalaM pUjitEH stutEH । tatPalaM samavApnoti SAlagrAmEkapUjanAt ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAcakraM yo vidvAn paSyati Druvam । arccayedvEzRavo nityaM tasya puRyaM niboDa me ॥ kowiliNgasahasrEryat pUjitErjAhnavItawe । kASIvAsAdyugAnyazwO dinenEkena tadBavet ॥ tasmAdBaktyEva madBaktEH prItyarTaM mama puttraka । karttavyaM sarvvadA martyEH SAlagrAmaSilArccanam ॥ SAlagrAmaSilArUpI yatra tizWati keSavaH । tatra devAH surA yakzA BuvanAni caturdaSa ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAgre yEH sakfcCrAdDaM kftaM Bavet । vasanti pitarastezAM vizRuloke na saMSayaH ॥ ye pibanti narA nityaM SAlagrAmaSilAjalam । paYcagavyasahasrEstu prASitEH kiM prayojanam ॥ prAyaScitte samutpanne kiM dAnEH kimupozaREH । cAndrAyaREH kiM hi tAdfk pItvA pAdodakaM SuciH ॥” iti pAdme uttaraKaRqe 127 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ kalerdaSasahasravarzAnantaraM sa ca BArataM tyaktrA yAsyati । yaTA, -- “SAlagrAmo harermUttirjagannATaSca BAratam । kalerdaSasahasrAnte yayO tyaktrA hareH padam ॥” iti brazRavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 6 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ tasyotpattilakzaRAdi yaTA, -- “SAlagrAmasamutpattiM SfRvantu paramAdButAm । gaRqakyA prAk tapastaptaM Bavantu mama devatAH ॥ sarvvAH puttrAH suKaM dAtuM janAnAmiti te surAH । tasyAstu tapasA hfzwA brahmavizRumaheSvarAH ॥ varaM dAtuM samudyuktA vavre sA svasya puttratAm । aSaktAstaM varaM dAtuM tadA SaptAstayA kruDA ॥ pratAraRaM mama surAH kftaM yasmAt punaH punaH । kIwayoniM prapadyeTAH krudDAste hyaSapaMSca tAm ॥ avicAryya vayaM SaptAstvayA yattapasodDatAH । tena karmmavipAkena jaqA kfzRA nadI Bava ॥ anyonyaSApaM SrutvetTaM mahAn kolAhalo'Bavat । prakampitAH surAH sA ca brahmARante vyajijYapat ॥ brahman trAhi mahASApAdanyonyapatitAt kruDA । iti devavacaH SrutvA brahmA SaNkaramabravIt ॥ SivaH provAca DAtAramahaM saMhArakArakaH । tvaM sfzwikarttA vizRustu pAlako budDimattaraH ॥ sa prazwavyo yaTAsaNKyamuBayoH samBavediti । iti mAheSvaraM SrutvA vacanaM vizRurabravIt ॥ SfRu brahman mahAdeva SfRu deva gajAnana । madgaRO brAhmaRO grAhamAtaNgO SApato'tra tu ॥ BavizyatastayormmokzaM BavizyAmi kalevaram । SIrRaM Bavizyati yadA tanmedomajjasamBavAH ॥ pAzARAntargatA kIwA vajrAKyA praBavizyaTa । adyEva gaRqakI puRyA gaNgAtulyA mahAnadI ॥ gaRqakyAM girirAjasya dakziRe daSayojanam । vistIrRaM tanmanuM kzattraM puRyakzetraM mahItale । cakratIrTamiti KyAtaM trizu lokezu viSrutam ॥ SAlagrAmagatA devA devodbArAvatIgataH । uBayoH saNgamo yatra muktistatra na saMSayaH ॥ sarvvadevaprItikarA BuktimuktipradAyinI । BavantvasyAntu pAzARA ye tadantargatA surAH ॥ prArTitaM svaM vinA sarvve vajrakIwA Bavantviti । anenEva tu gaRqakyAH puttratvaM BavatAmapi ॥ Bavizyati tadantaSca cihnaM taddEvatodBavam । vijYAya ye'rccayizyanti sA prItA tasya devatA ॥ na yantrasya na mUrtteSca na vfkzasyApi pUjanAt । santozo jAyate tezAM gaRqakyAM mArjjanAdyaTA ॥ iti vizRuvacaH SrutvA brahmA vacanamabravIt ॥ * ॥ kIdfk pUjyA SilA vizRoH kiYCidrA kasya vallaBA । kiM PalaM cADikArI ca kena mArgeRa tadvada ॥ iti brahmavacaH SrutvA vizRurvvacanamabravIt । svIyavarRA SilA pUjyA brAhmaRAdyEH suKAptaye ॥ snigDA SilA mantrasidDaM rUkzA sidDiM karoti ca । mecakA kIrttitA DOtANgAravat sA yaSoharA ॥ pARqU
